transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?
I'm seeking help because I've been struggling with extreme mood swings, periods of intense, uncontrollable energy, and hearing or seeing things that aren't there. It has been going on for
Do you experience these hallucinations (hearing or seeing things) only during your extreme mood swings, or do they also happen when your mood feels relatively normal and stable?

Yes, they definitely happen even when my mood is stable. There have been periods, lasting for two weeks or more, where I was hearing and seeing things but didn't have any of that extreme energy or mood swings.

latest_inference.note: Previously the candidates were Bipolar I Disorder with Psychotic Features, Schizoaffective Disorder (Bipolar Type), and Bipolar I Disorder. Based on the patient's confirmation that they experience hallucinations for two weeks or more during periods of stable mood (in the absence of major mood episodes), Bipolar I Disorder with Psychotic Features and Bipolar I Disorder are ruled out. This symptom profile meets the DSM-5 criteria for Schizoaffective Disorder (Bipolar Type).

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient experiences both manic episodes (periods of intense, uncontrollable energy) and psychotic symptoms (hallucinations). Crucially, the hallucinations persist for at least two weeks in the absence of any prominent mood symptoms, meeting the DSM-5 diagnostic criteria for Schizoaffective Disorder (Bipolar Type) and distinguishing it from Bipolar I Disorder with Psychotic Features.
